map.排卵日 = 末次月经 + 周期天数 − 14: Ovulation day = last menstrual period + cycle length − 14
map.易孕期 = 排卵日 −5 ~ +4；安全期 = 周期其余日期（日历法，仅适用于周: Fertile window = ovulation day −5 to +4; safe period = the remaining days of the cycle (calendar method, only for regular cycles)
map.推算排卵日与易孕期：输入末次月经、周期长度、经期天数，排卵日 ≈ LMP + (: Estimate the ovulation day and fertile window: enter the LMP, cycle length and period length; ovulation day ≈ LMP + (cycle − 14); fertile window = ovulation day ±5 days (sperm can survive several days).
map.推算下次月经：下次月经 ≈ LMP + 周期；月经期按经期天数标记。周期日历把每: Estimate the next period: next period ≈ LMP + cycle; the period is marked by the period length. The cycle calendar labels each day as period / fertile / safe.
map.认识安全期局限：排卵受情绪、疾病、压力影响会提前或推后，日历法只能做健康管理参考: Understand the limits of the safe period: ovulation can shift earlier or later due to emotions, illness and stress, so the calendar method is only a health-management reference and never a reliable contraceptive.
map.算例：LMP 2026-08-01、周期 28 天、经期 5 天: Example: LMP 2026-08-01, cycle 28 days, period 5 days
map.排卵日 = 8/1 + (28−14) = 8/15；易孕期 = 8/10 ~: Ovulation day = 8/1 + (28−14) = 8/15; fertile window = 8/10 to 8/19; next period = 8/29 (period 5 days from 8/29). ⚠️ The annual failure rate of safe-period contraception is about 24%, so it is not recommended as a contraceptive method.
map.安全期为什么不可靠？: Why is the safe period unreliable?
map.女性排卵可因压力、疾病、旅行等波动 ±数天，且精子宫内可存活约 5 天、卵子约: Women's ovulation can shift by ±several days due to stress, illness, travel and so on, and sperm can survive about 5 days in the uterus while the egg about 1 day, so the fertile window is wide and calendar estimation easily misses.
map.想避孕该用什么？: What should I use for contraception?
map.可靠方式包括避孕套、短效口服避孕药、宫内节育器等；安全期/体外射精失败率高，不建: Reliable methods include condoms, combined oral contraceptives and intrauterine devices; the safe period and withdrawal have high failure rates and are not recommended on their own. Consult a doctor as needed.
map.日历法假设排卵日 = 下次月经前 14 天，精子存活约 3–5 天、卵子 1 天: The calendar method assumes ovulation day = 14 days before the next period, with sperm surviving about 3-5 days and the egg 1 day
map.易孕期 = 排卵日前 5 天至后 4 天；其余为相对安全期: Fertile window = 5 days before to 4 days after ovulation; the rest is the relatively safe period
map.周期不规律、压力/疾病/旅行会影响排卵，日历法误差较大: Irregular cycles and stress/illness/travel affect ovulation, giving the calendar method a large error
map.结果不构成医疗或避孕建议，重要决策请咨询专业医生: The results are not medical or contraceptive advice; consult a professional doctor for important decisions
